documents_issued_complete_ck.name: documents_issued_complete_ck
documents_issued_complete_ck.value: "documents"."status" = 'draft' or ("documents"."number" is not null and "documents"."issued_at" is not null and "documents"."content_hash" is not null and "documents"."snapshot" is not null)

counterparties_active_registration_uq.name: counterparties_active_registration_uq
counterparties_active_registration_uq.where: "counterparties"."archived_at" is null and "counterparties"."registration_number" is not null

products_active_sku_uq.name: products_active_sku_uq
products_active_sku_uq.where: "products"."archived_at" is null and "products"."sku" is not null

stock_movements_sign_ck.name: stock_movements_sign_ck
stock_movements_sign_ck.value:
("stock_movements"."kind" in ('receipt', 'transfer_in', 'production_output') and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" in ('issue', 'transfer_out', 'production_consume') and "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        or "stock_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment'
